title: OpenAPI source lock
description: Immutable, human-approved lock binding this repository's corrected OpenAPI snapshot to one exact, publicly resolvable upstream commit. Shape is enforced offline and deterministically by scripts/lib/openapi-source-lock.mjs (no network access). Network verification -- that the commit resolves, that the source bytes/hash match what is actually hosted there, and that the composer reference is real -- is a separate, later concern and is never performed by this schema or its shape validator alone. The canonical docs/openapi-source-lock.json file must not exist, and sync-locked-openapi must not run, until a human has supplied and the verifier has confirmed real values for every field here.

repositoryUrl.description: HTTPS GitHub repository URL only, e.g. https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>. No other host or scheme, and no embedded credentials.

commit.description: The full 40-character lowercase hex commit SHA. Never a branch name (main), a tag, or a short SHA.

sourcePath.description: Canonical path to the source OpenAPI document within the locked repository, relative to its root. No absolute path, no parent-directory traversal, no placeholder text.

sourceBytes.description: Exact byte length of the locked source file, as it exists at the locked commit.

sourceSha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 digest of the exact locked source file bytes.

composerPath.description: Path to the generator/composer tool within the locked repository. Supply this together with composerVersion, or supply composerSha256 instead -- never both forms.

composerVersion.description: Version identifier of the generator/composer tool. Supply this together with composerPath, or supply composerSha256 instead -- never both forms.

composerSha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 digest of the generator/composer tool, supplied instead of composerPath+composerVersion.

approvedBy.description: Human approval identity for this exact lock (H01-LOCK). Never a placeholder.

approvedAt.description: ISO-8601 approval date/time for this exact lock (H01-LOCK).
